> Sagar Burse Consulting (SBC) is an Ahmedabad-based management consulting firm offering MSME consulting, institution building, strategic research & feasibility, and policy advisory — built on one principle: real implementation, not just advice, delivered through the GAP360™ framework, led by Dr. Sagar Burse, PhD.

## Home

[SBC | MSME Consulting & Business Advisory, Ahmedabad](https://sbcgroup.in/): Sagar Burse Consulting (SBC) is a business consultant in Ahmedabad offering MSME consulting, institution building, strategic research and policy advisory.

## Services

[MSME Consulting & Business Advisory | SBC, Ahmedabad](https://sbcgroup.in/msme-consulting): SBC's MSME consulting helps Indian businesses build systems, create accountability and grow on autopilot through GAP360™ — diagnosis, design and implementation.
[Institution Building & Skill Development | SBC, Ahmedabad](https://sbcgroup.in/institution-building-skill-development): End-to-end advisory for universities and skill centres — from vision to launch, navigating AICTE, UGC, NSDC, SSC and state regulatory bodies.
[Strategic Research & Feasibility Studies | SBC, Ahmedabad](https://sbcgroup.in/strategic-research-feasibility): Data-driven market research, feasibility studies and DPRs that turn information into strategic advantage — for MSMEs, institutions and industry bodies.
[Policy Advisory for Government Bodies | SBC, Ahmedabad](https://sbcgroup.in/policy-advisory): Research-backed, evidence-driven policy advisory for government bodies, industry associations and public institutions across India.
[GAP360™ — Growth Acceleration Pathway 360° | SBC](https://sbcgroup.in/gap360): GAP360™ is SBC's flagship gap analysis consulting framework — mapping Operations, Systems, People, Process and Strategy to deliver measurable results.

[Trading & Distribution Business | Case Study | Sagar Burse Consulting](https://sbcgroup.in/case-studies/trading-distribution-business): A 34% attrition rate was quietly bleeding the business, with unclear roles, inconsistent compensation, and a 45-day hiring cycle.
